_note: Churn-reason taxonomy. Each class maps to ONE retention action, because a label that does not change what the business does is not worth predicting.

price.definition: Cost is the stated blocker. Includes budget loss, 'not worth the money', cheaper-alternative-on-price.
price.action: Offer discount or downgrade to cheaper tier
price.action_cost_note: 3 months at 40% off on a $40/mo plan

content_gap.definition: Course library lacked the topic, depth, or level the learner needed. Includes quality complaints about teaching.
content_gap.action: Route to curriculum team + recommend alternative track

time.definition: Learner wants to continue but has no capacity right now. Life circumstances, workload.
time.action: Offer subscription pause instead of cancellation
time.action_cost_note: Pause is nearly free and defers revenue rather than losing it

goal_met.definition: Learner finished what they came for. Passed the exam, got the job, completed the track. Leaving satisfied.
goal_met.action: Request testimonial / referral. Do NOT discount.
goal_met.action_cost_note: Discounting this group is pure margin loss - they are done

technical.definition: Product defects blocked usage. Crashes, video playback, login, payment failures, mobile bugs.

support.definition: Negative experience with human support or billing admin. Unanswered tickets, surprise charges, refund friction.
support.action: Human follow-up from a senior agent

competitor.definition: Explicitly moving to a named or described alternative provider for reasons other than price.
competitor.action: Log competitive intel + targeted feature pitch

unclear.definition: Text carries no usable signal, is empty-ish, or is too ambiguous to act on. Correctly abstaining is a WIN, not a failure.
